title: A half-finished King
body: Feature-wise this should be the perfect TODO-app. On first look it seems to have everything. But add more than a few tasks over time and the Apple Watch app becomes downright unusable (never populates «My day») and performance when scrolling is sluggish on all devices . It looks like it’s GUI-performance is directly affected by problems syncing. A cache is needed and the Apple Watch app needs a complete overhaul in terms of sync issues. It kind of looks like it was tested it’s no actual data in the app.. Besides that it is a very good effort and could have been the king of the hill.

body:
Appen har sine fordeler, men den er utrolig irriterende å bruke av følgende årsaker: 1) når du lager ei liste, legger til ulike oppgaver og deretter vil sortere dem er det tilnærmet umulig å ikke ende opp med å klynge dem sammen i grupper når du prøver å legge den mellom et par oppgaver. Det nytter ikke hvor forsiktig du beveger gjøremålet nedover skjermen, den hopper kronisk til bunnen; og 2) Det burde være enklere å slette oppgaver på enn å klikke seg inn via små ikoner.

Håper dette kan fikses i fremtidige versjoner :)

author: PressAnyKey_NO

title: Sync is slow
body:
Like many others I migrated from Wunderlist. For me list sharing with my family and real-time list updates/sync are key functionalities. 
ToDo has very slow sync, and seems I have to click on a notification to get the latest item from another list member visible on my phone. You cannot have a five minute sync delay when you are at the end of your shopping trip and on your way to the cashier. 

In addition, I was added in someone’s else’s list, that was shared in Wunderlist. After, when importing all my lists these two identical lists seem to have been merged and all items in that list are now duplicated for me. The list owner of the list does only have one of each, so something is off with the sync. I can understand that there ended up with a merge/duplication, but not that the duplicates only show up in one members list.

Overall very disappointed with the first impression and looking for a better alternative.

author: jensnilsen

title: Hvorfor ødelegge wunderlist?
body:
Kommenterer som mange andre her; Wunderlist fungerte helt sømløst, var enkelt å dele og multiple kontoer (f.eks jobb og privat) var null problem.

I iOS appen er det omtrent umulig å dele lister, det er klønete å logge inn, ikke mulig med flere brukere, og det meste som fungerte bra i Wunderlist ser ut til å ikke fungere her. 

For meg isolert fungerer appen fint, men litt av poenget med en sånn app er jo å enkelt kunne dele f.eks en handleliste.

Om ikke det omgående kommer en forbedring i brukeropplevelsen blir det å se seg om etter noe annet. Ser det er tråder på microsoftforum om to-do og disse utfordringene helt tilbake til 2017. Kanskje på tide å gjøre noe Microsoft?

title: Flagg av e-post
body: Hvorfor dukker ikke flagget e-post i appen, men de dukker opp på appen på PC?
author: ken-sor

title: Not ready yet
body: As with many other products that Microsoft buys, it destroys it. I hope it’s not again this time. The bought Wunderlist and now are trying to create the same product under their scope (instead of the more easy, logical and simple solution that would be to simply rename the original one and keep improving it from there). You cannot add comments to notes (as you can in Wunderlist) and the biggest issue: The Today tab will delete all the pending tasks the next day. A huge usability issue where you will lose track of all the pending tasks from yesterday. Who the genius is within Microsoft who though this was a good idea escapes my understanding or never has used Wunderlist or this app and hasn’t experienced the frustration. If you’re a Wunderlist user, stay there. Nothing new or exciting here.

title: Glimrende - så langt
body: Flott Microsoft! Dette har vi ventet lenge på. Skjønner at dette er en tidlig preview versjon og mange funksjoner mangler enda (Først og fremst merking av app-symbol for oppgaver som forfaller), men funskjonene som virker fungerer strålende, ikke minst lynkjapp oppdatering mellom PC og Iphone app.
